summary: Validated the electron desktop build-fix. electron-builder gets past version resolution (log shows 'electron=31.7.7' and 'loaded configuration file=package.json') and only fails on 'wine is required' which is expected on this Linux pod. package.json is valid JSON with devDependencies.electron pinned to exact '31.7.7'. .yarnrc.yml contains exactly 'nodeLinker: node-modules'. Electron harness (DISPLAY=:99 + /tmp/eltest config + frontend on :3000) emitted HARNESS_PASS confirming the pinned electron 31.7.7 runtime still works end-to-end (shim, confirm, alert, keyboard input after dialogs). Static review of /app/windows/build-desktop.bat found no concrete cmd-syntax bugs (CRLF endings, proper quoting, errorlevel after each `call yarn ...`, _env.bat invoked, cd into %ROOT%\desktop).
action_items: Optional: regenerate /app/desktop/yarn.lock so the key is 'electron@31.7.7:' instead of the current 'electron@^31.3.1:' (resolved version is already 31.7.7, so builds work, but `yarn install --frozen-lockfile` on a clean checkout will fail because package.json now requests exact 31.7.7 and no matching lockfile key exists). A plain `yarn install` on a dev machine will refresh it.
critical_code_review_comments: build-desktop.bat line 25 `for /f "tokens=2 delims=:, " %%V in ('findstr /C:"\"version\"" node_modules\electron\package.json')` will capture the token with surrounding quotes stripped by %%~V - works, but relies on findstr returning only one matching line. electron/package.json has exactly one top-level "version" field so this is safe today; a future stray "version" string in package.json would print multiple lines. Non-blocking.

yarn.lock still lists `electron@^31.3.1:` as the resolution key; package.json now pins to '31.7.7'. electron-builder works because the resolved version in the lock is 31.7.7, but strict installs (--frozen-lockfile / --immutable) will fail until the lockfile is regenerated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: electron-builder on this Linux pod will ALWAYS fail at 'wine is required' (or ERR_ELECTRON_BUILDER_CANNOT_EXECUTE on arm64 app-builder-bin) - that is NOT a bug. The success signal is the line 'electron=31.7.7' appearing before the wine error. Electron harness requires Xvfb :99 + frontend :3000 up + XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/eltest + --no-sandbox (root).
rca of the issue: Original user bug: `yarn build:win` failed with 'Cannot compute electron version from installed node modules'. Dual root cause: (a) devDependencies.electron was a caret range ^31.3.1, (b) node_modules/electron missing on the user's PC (Yarn Berry PnP mode or failed install). Fix applied by E1 - pin to exact '31.7.7' + add .yarnrc.yml nodeLinker: node-modules + add build-desktop.bat that verifies node_modules\electron\package.json exists post-install - correctly addresses both causes. Verified: electron-builder resolves version=31.7.7 from node_modules on Linux pod.
